verdict.rationale: An audit trail of who changed what and when is a fair question for a general-ledger accounting product, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a change log, edit history or user-attributed audit trail across the ledger. Related items, such as exception surfacing in the Agentic Close and firm roles and permissions, are different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger
